functional_correctness.description: Evaluates whether the code correctly implements the requirements of the task as specified in the prompt.

edge_case_handling.description: Assesses how well the code handles edge cases or unusual inputs that could affect its performance or correctness.

efficiency.description: Measures the time complexity of the solution and whether it meets the performance requirements outlined in the prompt.

robustness.description: Evaluates the code's ability to handle unexpected inputs or conditions without crashing or producing incorrect results.

api_usage.description: Assesses the appropriateness and correctness of using APIs or libraries relevant to the programming task.

readability.description: Measures how easy it is to read and understand the code, including naming conventions and code structure.

maintainability.description: Evaluates how easy it is to modify or extend the code, considering factors like complexity and documentation.

error_handling_security.description: Assesses how well the code anticipates and handles potential errors, user inputs, or security concerns.
